extracted.intended_audience: readers and scholars of history of science and early modern mathematics
extracted.subtask_description: A historical/biographical account of Thomas Hariot's life, scientific work (especially his algebra/Analytics), relationships with contemporaries (Raleigh, Vieta, Descartes, Wallis), illness, death, and posthumous reputation and manuscript fate. Contains narrative, letters, publication history, and commentary on controversies about priority and influence.
